tg_attributes.name: loginfmt
tg_attributes.class: form-control ltr_override input ext-input text-box ext-text-box
tg_attributes.data-bind:
attr: { lang: svr.fApplyAsciiRegexOnInput ? null : 'en',
                    autocomplete: svr.fEnablePasskeyAutofillUI ? 'username webauthn' : 'username' },
                    externalCss: {
                        'input': true,
                        'text-box': true,
                        'has-error': usernameTextbox.error },
                    ariaLabel: tenantBranding.unsafe_userIdLabel || str['CT_PWD_STR_Username_AriaLabel'],
                    ariaDescribedBy:
                        'usernameError winBodyHeader winBodySubHeader loginHeader' + (pageDescription && !svr.fHideLoginDesc ? ' loginDescription' : ''),
                    textInput: usernameTextbox.value,
                    hasFocusEx: usernameTextbox.focused,
                    placeholder: $placeholderText

tg_attributes.name: passwd

                    showCredViewBrandingDesc ? 'credViewBrandingDesc' : '',

                hasFocusEx: passwordTextbox.focused() && !showPassword(),
                placeholder: $placeholderText,
                ariaLabel: unsafe_passwordAriaLabel,
                moveOffScreen: showPassword,
                externalCss: {
                    'input': true,
                    'text-box': true,
                    'has-error': passwordTextbox.error,
                    'show-reveal-password': svr.fFixShowRevealPassword }
